On October 27, 2025, Judge Stein of the Southern District of New York denied OpenAI’s motion to dismiss the output-based copyright infringement claims brought by a class of authors including David Baldacci, George R.R. Martin, and others.

A new ruling in Authors Guild v. OpenAI has major implications for copyright law, well beyond artificial intelligence. On October 27, 2025, Judge Sidney Stein of the Southern District of New York denied OpenAI’s motion to dismiss claims that ChatGPT outputs infringed the rights of authors such as George R.R.
